question: Aceites Abasa company history
markdown:
Founded in 1997
with fewer than five employees,
⁠Aceites Abasa
began as a local bottler and distributor serving olive oil mills in Baena, Spain. Over the past 25 years, it has grown into a major international enterprise with over 65 employees, exporting olive and vegetable oils to more than 45 countries.
Aceites Abasa
Company Growth and Evolution
1997:
Established in Spain near the prominent olive-producing Baena region.
Early Operations:
Started by providing local crushing mills with bottling and distribution services.
Global Expansion:
Expanded market reach to serve clients across more than 45 countries worldwide.
Modern Scale:
Grew past 65 employees with strong double-digit growth. You can read more about their corporate background on the

page or review trade data via

Core Services and Offerings
Product Line:
Specializes in extra virgin olive oil, virgin olive oil, avocado oil, grapeseed oil, and other vegetable oils.
Business Model:
Focuses on bulk sales, consumer brands, and custom private-label bottling.
